query: query baton_pullRequests($userId: ID!, $after: String) { atlassianUserPullRequests(userId: $userId, since: "P90D", first: 25, after: $after) { edges { node { __typename ... on ExternalPullRequest { id displayId title url status lastUpdatedAt repositoryId author { id name } reviewers { approvalStatus user { id name } } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
